mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 7.

A group of young people and citizens gathered again in Tirana on Sunday before the Ministry of Education, continuing protests demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama and his government.

U.S. election campaigns have now attracted billions of dollars, and Senator Bernie Sanders has renewed his criticism of the billionaire class, recalling his eight-and-a-half-hour Senate speech from December 2010.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told President Donald Trump in a phone call that Israel would like the United States to consider a military strike on Iran after the upcoming U.S. midterm elections.

Italian driver Kimi Antonelli made history by becoming the youngest Formula 1 world champion at age 20, the first teenager to win the title.

Sunderland midfielder Granit Xhaka said he was disappointed after a 3-1 defeat to Coventry City, blaming simple mistakes for the loss.
